logic.description: Implemented (2026-10-29). The left-clicked free tile within 10 hexes (general_ux_range_cast_target; none chosen or not free → a random free known tile within 10) receives me or the adjacent ally with less life (tie → me). ∀: instant (general_ux_instants).

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
Either no tile was chosen (random free tile within 10) or the chosen tile is within 10 hexes of the caster; it must be free at resolution.

effects.description: Hex distance the caster jumps (any free tile; no range cap in the engine).
The adjacent ally with the lowest life below mine moves; otherwise I do.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_space (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
The ∀ double-cast bonus text stays present (the engine unlocks it on a Rule 23 chained cast).

note: ) not free within 10 — random tile instead
